content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters

So, what exactly is NOWPayments, and why should you care? Simply put, NOWPayments is a payment gateway that enables you to directly receive crypto payments on your static site, bypassing traditional payment processors like Stripe and PayPal. This means you can focus on creating, rather than worrying about payment gateways and the associated fees. With NOWPayments, you get to keep 100% of your earnings, minus the 0.5% fee, of course. But what's more, NOWPayments is built on a robust architecture that ensures secure, fast, and reliable transactions. Whether you're selling ebooks, courses, or software, NOWPayments has got you covered. And the best part? It's not just limited to USDT; you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Litecoin. This opens up a whole new world of payment possibilities for creators like you.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

Now, let's take a closer look at how NOWPayments works under the hood. In simple terms, the architecture involves a combination of Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. Cloudflare Pages serves as the hosting platform for your static site, while Cloudflare Workers handle the backend logic and automate tasks. Supabase, on the other hand, is used for order storage and management. Meanwhile, NOWPayments takes care of the payment processing, verification, and webhook notifications. With this robust architecture, you can rest assured that your payments are processed securely and efficiently. And the best part? It's all done without relying on traditional payment processors like Stripe and PayPal.
Who This Is Built For and Why

So, who exactly is NOWPayments built for? In short, it's designed for digital creators like you who struggle with payment gateways and the associated fees. Whether you're selling digital products or services, NOWPayments provides a seamless and secure way to receive payments directly on your static site. With its 0.5% fee and no KYC requirements, NOWPayments is an attractive option for creators who want to keep more of their earnings. And with its robust architecture and user-friendly interface, NOWPayments is perfect for creators of all levels, from beginners to seasoned pros.
USDT on Tron settles in under 60 seconds for less than $0.10 in network fees — no payout schedule, no minimum threshold.
The Components That Make It Work Together

So, what are the key components that make NOWPayments work together seamlessly? At its core, NOWPayments relies on a combination of Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. These components work together to provide secure, fast, and reliable transactions. Cloudflare Pages serves as the hosting platform for your static site, while Cloudflare Workers handle the backend logic and automation. Supabase takes care of order storage and management, and NOWPayments handles payment processing, verification, and webhook notifications. With this robust architecture, you can trust that your payments are processed securely and efficiently.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

So, how can you use this knowledge to deploy NOWPayments today? First, start by signing up for a NOWPayments account and setting up your static site on Cloudflare Pages. Next, configure Cloudflare Workers to automate tasks and handle backend logic. Then, set up Supabase for order storage and management. Finally, integrate NOWPayments into your static site, and you're good to go! With this step-by-step guide, you can deploy NOWPayments in no time and start accepting secure, fast, and reliable crypto payments on your static site.
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

The most important question on everyone's mind: How long does USDT payment take to arrive compared to PayPal? The answer is simple: USDT payments on Tron and Solana can take days to settle, unlike PayPal's lightning-fast US bank transfer speeds. But with NOWPayments, you can receive USDT payments in real-time, securely and efficiently. No more waiting for days or even weeks for your USDT settlements to clear.
Your revenue lands in a wallet you control the moment the transaction confirms on-chain.

Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy NOWPayments today, follow these concrete steps: (1) Sign up for a NOWPayments account; (2) Set up your static site on Cloudflare Pages; (3) Configure Cloudflare Workers to automate tasks and handle backend logic; (4) Set up Supabase for order storage and management; (5) Integrate NOWPayments into your static site; (6) Test and verify payment processing; (7) Optimize your payment flow for maximum efficiency.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

With NOWPayments, you can directly receive crypto payments on your static site, bypassing traditional payment processors like Stripe and PayPal. Simply set up a NOWPayments account, configure your static site, and integrate NOWPayments – and you're good to go!
What is the 0.5% fee for using NOWPayments?

The 0.5% fee is a flat rate that covers the costs of payment processing, verification, and webhook notifications. This means you get to keep 99.5% of your earnings, minus the fee, of course. But, considering the convenience and security of NOWPayments, it's a small price to pay for peace of mind.
Can I accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with NOWPayments?
Yes, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with NOWPayments, including USDT, Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Litecoin. This opens up a whole new world of payment possibilities for creators like you.
How do I convert Bitcoin to naira or shillings through P2P exchanges like Binance's Patricia?

With NOWPayments, you don't need to worry about converting Bitcoin to naira or shillings through P2P exchanges. Simply integrate NOWPayments into your static site, and you'll receive payments in the cryptocurrency of your choice, without any conversion hassles.
